name: balenaEtcher image writer
description: Official cross-platform utility for writing supported OS images to USB drives and SD cards from Windows, macOS or Linux. Image and target-device compatibility must be checked separately.
license_note: balenaEtcher is open source under its published licence. The OS images written with it have separate publisher licences and verification requirements.

tutorials.title: balenaEtcher official documentation
tutorials.scope: Official documentation for selecting an image, selecting removable media and flashing.
notes: Writing an image overwrites the selected target drive.
Not every Windows installer ISO is supported as a directly bootable image; follow the OS publisher's recommended tool.
Writing an image erases the selected USB drive or SD card; confirm the exact removable device before flashing.
Available for Windows, macOS and Linux; check the release architecture.
Verify the image from the OS publisher before writing.
Double-check the target device and capacity; never select the system disk.
Not a phone firmware flashing tool.
